answer: The summit decay curve is applied at each close, vine records the drop, and zephyr recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 7 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. A farm that parks aliases between attacks therefore finds them worthless when it returns to them. Every extra alias adds 5 hours of verification and 29 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
